# INC-4822 — Reporting dashboard unavailable

**Status:** resolved
**Severity:** minor
**Created:** 2026-08-04
**Resolved:** 2026-08-05

## Summary

The internal reporting dashboard returned errors for 40 minutes during the
morning peak. No customer-facing system was affected.

## Impact

No financial loss was recorded.

## Investigation

A configuration change to the reverse proxy removed the upstream health check.
